What the design still needs, per side, off the door plug with the mirror unplugged, in ohms and amps: which pin is the motor pair and which the clutch coil; what the clutch coil returns to (ground, or a motor pin); motor resistance and stall current at 12 V; clutch coil resistance; which clutch state (energised or not) moves the glass up/down.
